title: SysV / POSIX IPC subsystem implementation
summary: Implemented the SysV + POSIX IPC subsystem family (sem, shm, msg, mq) per 08_SYSV_IPC_v1.md. SysV shm now has PageBacked shmat/shmdt mappings, attach-count accounting, process-exit detach sweeps, and IPC_RMID marked-for-deletion lifetime with namespace-key withdrawal. Focused host verification passes; guest IPC smoke still needs a fresh rerun after the shm lifetime fix.
